en.name: Lassi
en.summary: A chilled bottle of lassi keeps about 1 week unopened in the fridge, to its printed date, and 1–2 days once opened or once you have blended it at home. It is a cultured milk drink, so once the seal is broken the clock is short: the culture keeps working, and the drink sours and separates.
en.pantry: Lassi is a fresh dairy drink and has no room-temperature timeline. Between 4 °C and 60 °C it sits in the range where bacteria multiply, so follow the two-hour rule: more than two hours out of the fridge and it goes, or one hour above 32 °C. The culture in it gives some protection through acidity, but that is not the same as being shelf-stable. Retort-packed shelf-stable lassi is a different product and keeps unrefrigerated until it is opened.
en.fridge: About 1 week for a sealed chilled bottle, to the date on the label, and 1–2 days once opened. Home-blended lassi is a fresh dairy drink from the moment the blender stops: chill it straight away and drink it the same day if you can. It separates within hours, which is quality rather than spoilage and shakes back together. A jug that has stood on the table through a long meal is a different matter and should be discarded rather than returned to the fridge.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published for lassi. Freezing splits a yoghurt drink — the protein and water separate and the texture turns grainy — so it is not a sensible way to keep it. If you have mango lassi you cannot finish, freezing it as ice lollies works far better than freezing it as a drink, because nobody minds the texture in that form.
en.thawing: Not recommended for drinking. If you have frozen lassi, thaw it in the fridge and expect it to be separated; blending helps but does not fully restore it.
spoilage: A sharply sour or yeasty smell beyond the normal tang of yoghurt.
Fizzing or a bottle that has swollen, meaning gas is being produced.
Lumps or curds that do not shake back in.
Any mould at the neck of the bottle or on the surface.
tips: Blend only as much as you will drink; lassi is at its best within the hour.
Keep the bottle on a fridge shelf rather than in the door.
Separation is normal — shake it rather than throwing it out.
Freeze leftover mango lassi as ice lollies instead of trying to keep it as a drink.

faq.q: How long does lassi keep in the fridge?
faq.a: About 1 week unopened for a chilled bottle, to its printed date, and 1–2 days once opened or home-blended. These figures are read across from kefir.
Not usefully. Freezing splits it and the texture turns grainy. Freezing it as ice lollies is the better use for leftovers.

faq.q: My lassi has separated. Has it gone off?
faq.a: Separation within hours is normal for a yoghurt drink and shakes back in. A sharply sour smell, fizzing or curds that will not disperse mean it goes.

zh.name: 印度優格飲（lassi）
zh.summary: 冷藏櫃買的瓶裝 lassi 未開封大約可放 1 週、以標示日期為準；開封後或自己在家打的，則是 1～2 天。它是發酵乳飲品，封口一開時間就很短：菌會繼續作用，飲料會變酸、也會分層。
zh.pantry: lassi 是新鮮乳製飲品，沒有室溫的期限。4 °C 到 60 °C 之間正是細菌繁殖的溫度帶，所以請遵守兩小時原則：離開冰箱超過兩小時就倒掉；室溫超過 32 °C 時，一小時就是上限。裡面的菌種靠酸度提供一些保護，但那和「可以常溫保存」是兩回事。經過高溫滅菌的常溫包裝 lassi 是不同的產品，開封前可以不冷藏。
zh.fridge: 冷藏櫃的密封瓶裝約 1 週、以標示日期為準；開封後 1～2 天。自己打的 lassi，從果汁機停下來那一刻起就是新鮮乳製飲品：請立刻冷藏，可以的話當天喝完。它幾個小時內就會分層，那是品質而不是腐敗，搖一搖就回來了。但一整頓飯都放在桌上的那一壺是另一回事，請倒掉，不要再放回冰箱。
zh.freezer: lassi 沒有公布的冷凍期限。冷凍會讓優格飲分離——蛋白質和水分家，質地變得粗糙——所以這不是合理的保存方式。如果芒果 lassi 喝不完，做成冰棒會比凍成飲料好得多，因為那個型態下沒人會在意質地。
zh.thawing: 不建議解凍後當飲料喝。若已冷凍，請放冷藏解凍，並預期它是分離的；重新打過會好一些，但回不到原樣。
spoilage: 酸味尖銳或有酵母味，超出優格本來的那種酸香。
起泡，或瓶身鼓脹，代表有氣體產生。
出現搖不回去的結塊或凝乳。
tips: 要喝多少打多少；lassi 在一小時內最好喝。
瓶子放冰箱層架，不要放門邊。
分層是正常的——搖勻就好，不必丟掉。
喝不完的芒果 lassi 做成冰棒，比想辦法留成飲料實際。

faq.a: 冷藏瓶裝未開封約 1 週、以標示日期為準；開封或自製後 1～2 天。這些數字是比照克菲爾而來。
意義不大。冷凍會讓它分離、質地變粗。喝不完做成冰棒是比較好的用法。
幾小時內分層對優格飲來說很正常，搖勻就好。酸味尖銳、起泡，或出現搖不散的凝塊，才代表該倒掉。
